statement: For women 40+ in 'hormonal chaos' (exhausted, bloated, meno belly, hot flashes, low libido) who have 'tried everything', Arctic Goddess is the ancestral nutrition (freeze-dried wild Arctic reindeer organs + Arctic herbs, 2 capsules a day) that refills the nutrient depletion behind midlife hormone symptoms. Unlike HRT, synthetic supplements, Ozempic and diets, it 'nourishes the root cause' with food 'your body instantly recognizes', proven by indigenous Arctic women who 'didn't show the same menopausal aging', a Norwegian factory tour and '100,000+ women have switched'.
category_language: 'ancestral nutrition' / 'food-based formula' / 'the original superfood' / 'Arctic organs and herbs supplement for women in their 40s and 50s'; explicitly 'not a diet, not a fat burner' (m2221103205393590, 97d). The PDP slug names the outcome bluntly: /products/ancestral-waist-thighs-slimmer-for-mature-women.
price_tier: premium (inferred: no dollar price is named in any of 150 scripts; 'small seasonal batches sell out', 'the next harvest', freeze-dried wild organs from Norway and a 60% off 'biggest sale of the year' imply a high list price)
enemy: Modern processed food ('chemically processed, biologically empty'), the supplement shelf ('black cohosh, ashwagandha, magnesium and melatonin pile up without refilling depletion'), synthetic hormones/HRT, Ozempic ('suppresses metabolism'), farmed beef-liver supplements ('carry contaminants'), doctors who say it is 'normal' or 'part of meno', bloat teas, and 'the system' that excluded women from trials.
stands_for: Midlife symptoms are starvation, not aging or willpower: refill the body with the dense ancestral food it was designed for and the hormones sort themselves out.

one_line: Bearaby sells hand-knit, bead-free weighted blankets (and now bamboo sheets and pillows) to stressed women and busy moms as a cozy, sustainable way to calm down and sleep. It scales on creator UGC and founder-led science stories, not on offers.
statement: For women who can't switch off at night and want rest that feels like self-care, Bearaby is the weighted blanket that gives deep-pressure calm without overheating. Unlike plastic-bead blankets, it is hand-knit from organic cotton or Tencel, proven by '300,000 plus sleepers' and an award-winning founder story.
category_language: weighted blanket, deep pressure therapy, deep touch pressure, nervous system, self-care, unwind, wind down, relaxation season, hug
price_tier: premium
enemy: Plastic-bead weighted blankets that make you 'feel like an oven' (m1371971444871342, 99d; m1094305943276261, 100d); for the sheets, bacteria in ordinary sheets.
stands_for: Rest is something you are allowed to take, and it should feel soft, natural and beautiful.

one_line: Two products, one engine. The front end is a long-form 'doctors dismissed me, a specialist named the real cause' advertorial: 4-15 minutes, run either voiced or as silent on-screen text, with hook swaps on one fixed body. Behind it is a large retargeting layer of silent coupon-stack text videos and 4-10s bumpers, all closing on a 90-day no-return guarantee. Provitalize (menopause probiotic: hips, joints, belly) runs on pages m103306058643323, m2390405827894921 and m878783481992317 (AU). Radiancy (vaginal-health collagen/probiotic) runs on page m409588712234260.

Bioma sells a two-capsule synbiotic (pro/pre/postbiotic) to US women 40+ as a gut fix for cravings, bloating and belly weight, and to men 35+ as a 'natural GLP-1 booster'; it scales on a few long-lived copy families (cortisol detox, 'normal poop', 'weight loss made easy', 35-60% off) each carrying dozens of creator cuts launched in one May 2026 drop.
statement: For women 40+ who eat clean and still fight cravings, bloat and a stubborn belly, Bioma is the two-capsule synbiotic that fixes the gut 'root cause' so weight loss feels easy. Unlike plain probiotics or fiber, it feeds its bacteria with XOS and tributyrin, proven by '400,000 women' and creator before/afters.
category_language: synbiotic, gut reset, gut signalling, root cause, natural GLP-1, cortisol detox, food noise, flat belly
price_tier: mid
enemy: dieting harder (crash diets, crunches, running, cutting carbs), fiber and laxatives, and for men the muscle loss of injections
stands_for: Your weight is not willpower; fix the gut (and the cortisol it says the gut controls) and the body stops fighting you.

one_line: Calm sells a subscription stress app, now led by one feature (EMDR-inspired bilateral audio / 'Deep Rest'), to stressed adults who feel their nervous system won't stand down; it scales on huge test volume (9,529 videos, 232 winners) pushed almost entirely through quiz funnels.
statement: For stressed adults who feel their body and mind will not slow down, Calm is the stress app that quiets the nervous system with sound. Unlike meditation or breathing exercises, it asks for nothing but listening ('Not meditation, not breathing exercises, just sound'), borrowing credibility from EMDR therapy.
category_language: nervous system, regulate / settle / slow down, tension, mental fog, racing mind, EMDR-inspired bilateral audio, Deep Rest, feel like myself again
price_tier: mid
enemy: chronic pressure and a nervous system stuck on; implicitly, effortful self-care ('it became one more thing I had to do') and willpower over thoughts ('fighting your thoughts wears you out')
stands_for: Stress is in the body, and you can let it go without effort.

statement: For menopausal and perimenopausal women (plus a broader stressed, sleepless 40+ buyer) who are stuck with meno belly, 3am waking and constant stress, Calmi is the wearable magnetotherapy-and-acupressure ring that calms the stress response so the body 'stops holding on' to belly weight. Unlike pills, supplements, diets or screen-based trackers, it is 'hormone-free, non-prescription', 'no charging, no app', and looks like 18k gold jewellery, proven by '100,000 women', a clinician endorsement, '1,000 scientific studies on magnetotherapy' and a 90-day refund.
category_language: 'wearable wellness ring', 'magnetotherapy ring', 'the original magnetotherapy and acupressure ring', 'menopause relief', 'natural weight loss ally' (PDP slugs: calmi-ring-relieve-menopause-naturally, calmi-ring-the-natural-weight-loss-ally, calmi-ring-the-original).
price_tier: Mid-price impulse jewellery (inferred): permanently discounted, '40% OFF TODAY' or BOGO; one PDP slug reads 'the-original-bogo-49' (inferred about $49 for the BOGO pair). Exact price never said in scripts.
enemy: Pills and supplements ('you don't need to ingest supplements and risk health problems', m1453693792733270, 122d), diets and workouts ('stop trying to fix your belly the wrong way', m954509857600940), screen trackers ('skip another expensive health tracker', m854112491077856), and cheap Amazon/AliExpress knockoffs (13 scripts).
stands_for: A no-effort, drug-free, beautiful thing you put on in the morning that calms the stress signal behind menopause belly, bad sleep and anxiety.

statement: For adults (women 25-45 who unwind with wine, sober and sober-curious couples, busy professionals) who want an evening wind-down without alcohol, U-Relax is the 5-calorie calming mocktail mix that takes the edge off in about 20 minutes. Unlike wine or beer, it gives the ritual and the relaxation without hangover, calories or wrecked sleep, proven by '22 million servings', '1 million orders' and creator testimonials.
category_language: alcohol alternative / non-alcoholic cocktail / calming mocktail / calming drink mix / calming tonic; 'dual action cortisol support' appears only in 2.0-era (Sep 2026+) creative
price_tier: mid (inferred: subscription box '$36' vs '$89'/'$119 value', '$29.85' birthday price, up to 28-58% off first order)
enemy: the nightly glass of wine / beer as a stress manager (hangovers, empty calories, disrupted sleep); secondarily 'most stress products only do one thing'
stands_for: Keep the evening drink ritual, drop the alcohol: calm you can feel tonight without the morning cost.

statement: For Spanish-speaking women (and a secondary line of men) over 30 whose belly and bloating have not moved despite years of strict diets, Cortisol Detox (formula.care) is the 28-day 'dieta del cortisol' meal-plan app that flattens the belly by calming stress hormones with real food instead of restriction. Unlike keto, calorie counting and 'matarte de hambre' [starving yourself], it says restriction itself traps cortisol under fat, proven by a nutritionist persona (Olivia Harper), day-7/14/21/28 diaries and pound-for-pound testimonials (m1036272325879591 3d, m1045495198094981 1d, m1141130012202052 0d).
category_language: 'la dieta del cortisol' / 'reto Cortisol Detox' / 'reinicio de cortisol de 28 días' [cortisol diet / Cortisol Detox challenge / 28-day cortisol reset]; body copy: 'Plan de alimentación #1 para bajar el cortisol — Ideal para principiantes' (all /es scripts). The product is a meal plan plus a challenge, framed as a diet with a hormone mechanism, never as a supplement.
price_tier: Not stated in any script or body copy; inferred quiz-gated app subscription (formula.care template shared with Hashimoto, Anti-Inflammatory and Carnivore funnels). No price, discount or guarantee appears in 50 scripts.
enemy: Starvation and strict diets: 'matarte de hambre atrapa el cortisol bajo la grasa' (m1036272325879591); 'las dietas estrictas como el keto no funcionan' (m1036272325879591); 'cuentas cada caloría, pero ignoras el cortisol' (m1057441250329457); 'deja de castigarte con dietas y cardio que no funcionan' (m1050575874488703).
stands_for: You are not failing because you eat too much; you are failing because stress hormones are holding the weight, and eating calmly for 28 days fixes what three years of dieting could not.

one_line: A creator-volume machine: one 2oz shot sold by taste, ease and 'clinically backed' across ~10 talking-head templates, each script cut into 3-13 hook-swapped siblings, shipped in 5-10-ad cohorts every 1-3 weeks to per-angle landing pages built with Jurni, with the offer (30% off, BOGO, restart) living mostly in primary text.

A volume machine that sells one mushroom coffee as a 'cortisol coffee' through about ten repeatable skit, callout and offer-story templates, re-cutting each winning body into new hooks, cast members, audiences and landing pages, and relaunching proven files as new ads every month.

Goli sells zero-sugar per-need wellness gummies (ashwagandha, apple cider vinegar, pre/pro/postbiotics, NAD+) to a mass TikTok Shop audience, and scales on creator affiliate UGC that pairs a rapid symptom list or a per-need roll call with a stacked-discount bundle, about half of its winners being pure 'tap the orange cart' deal scripts.
statement: For the mass-market wellness shopper who wants to fix cravings, bloating, stress and low energy without dieting, Goli is the zero-sugar gummy stack that gives one tasty gummy per need. Unlike $35-a-bottle single supplements in store, it bundles all three for 'basically the price of one' through TikTok Shop (m1538312647669193, 121d).
category_language: gummies, zero sugar, bundle, trio, six pack, 'one for your cravings, one for your mood, one for your gut', 'clinically studied KSM-66 ashwagandha', 'gluten-free, non-GMO, vegan'
price_tier: value
enemy: overpriced single bottles in store ('Do not buy these in store. They're $35 a pop', m1538312647669193) and, in the problem-led scripts, a 'messed up' gut and failed juice cleanses/12-day gut resets
stands_for: Wellness as an affordable, tasty daily habit you buy on a deal: one gummy for every need.

statement: For women over 40 (perimenopause through postmenopause) who feel like a stranger in their own body (stubborn weight, puffy face, 3am waking, brain fog, snapping at everyone) and have been told it is normal, their age or their willpower, Hormone Harmony is the daily plant-extract 'hormone balancing formula' that targets high cortisol and the after-40 hormonal shift so they feel like themselves again. Unlike diets, cardio, fat burners, single-symptom supplement stacks and doctors who say 'normal', it addresses the source with 11-12 adaptogens 'precisely dosed by a top German nutritional scientist with 20 years of experience', proven by '2.8 million women agree it works', 53,000 reviews and a 60-day 'either it works or it's free' guarantee.
category_language: 'hormone balancing formula' / 'natural formula that targets high cortisol' / 'daily formula' / 'smart extracts for women over 40' / 'complete hormone protocol reset' / '90-day hormone reset' / 'hormone optimizing protocol' / 'daily cortisol ritual' (page name). Explicitly 'not a fat burner, not a meal replacement' (m1037849612531645, 97d). The word 'cortisol' appears in 28 of 89 transcripts; 'hormones' is the umbrella in the rest. Never 'detox'.
price_tier: mid (inferred): no USD price in any US script; one UK creative prices it at 'two pounds 29 a day' (m1015631071521362, 0d), roughly £69/month; a creator calls it 'super affordable' (m1095334183282228, 1d); discount headlines of 36% and 26% (m1762548254788721, 36d; m1366688978995453, 0d).
enemy: Self-blame and the 'eat less, move more' willpower story ('the biggest lie we get told about our bodies as we get older', m1713158423067573, 62d); doctors who say 'normal for your age' or 'too young, try yoga' (m1593443112137108, 72d; m1912505966061903, 88d); the supplement-per-symptom stack ('a supplement for sleep, a supplement for stress, another for energy', m1055690416881507, 67d); quick fixes and supplement hopping (m1762548254788721, 36d); and the hidden hormone itself, high cortisol, personified as rage, puffy face and belly (m4400028513572912, 86d; m1780008229829472, 91d).
stands_for: Absolution: 'the problem was never your effort, it was your hormones' (m1037849612531645, 97d), delivered as 'feel like yourself again' by a brand that reuses one proof line (millions of women) under hundreds of cheap creator cuts.

statement: For men and women over 40 whose stubborn belly, broken sleep and exhaustion never responded to dieting, cardio or 'manage your stress' advice, Harmonia is the 'cortisol cocktail' (one orange-tasting scoop in water every morning) that brings cortisol back into rhythm so the body stops storing fat around the middle. Unlike fat burners, single-ingredient Amazon ashwagandha, GLP-1 shots or HRT, it is a 'complete formula at clinical doses' (KSM-66, phosphatidylserine, rhodiola, L-theanine, inositols, turmeric) backed by a claimed '2023 study of 1,200 men' and '22 randomized controlled trials' on KSM-66.
category_language: 'cortisol cocktail' / 'cortisol detox cocktail' / 'cortisol detox drink' (product named by category before brand, e.g. m2338296460311235, 118d); programme language: 'cortisol detox challenge', 'Harmonia Reset', 'cortisol reset', 'cortisol restoration, not a fat burner' (m1669926804562122).
price_tier: mid (inferred): 'our price starts from $39.99' (m1908330189883238, 105d); 'under one dollar a day' (m1066319076103861, 34d); 'less than one dollar a cup' (m1400947961888239, 34d); three packs = 90 days (m2341537866587150, 45d); every offer cut is '60% off'.
enemy: Doctors who say 'manage your stress', 'it's your age', 'eat less, move more' (stolen-jar family, m1989355328448788 49d; m1723010685613955 42d); cheap underdosed single-ingredient ashwagandha, detox teas and apps (m1908330189883238 105d; m1575862744165325 P.S.); fat burners, testosterone boosters, liver cleanses (m1866150441465756); 'the multi-billion dollar fitness industry' (m1831291244524746 35d); pharma 'selling menopausal women four products for one problem' (m993953883396780, 2d); beer itself is exonerated: 'Alcohol isn't the real problem' (m891217880306052 34d).
stands_for: You were never lazy, undisciplined or just old: a stress hormone stuck 'on' has been storing your fat and stealing your sleep, and one morning scoop that resets the rhythm gives you (or the person you love) your body and mind back.

one_line: Health Time is an image-advertorial publisher, not a video brand: this video read is a complete census of all 8 videos the page has ever run (7 transcripts, 0 winners, 6 of 8 are partner placements for third-party quiz funnels), so the formats below are what it tested in video, while its durable creative engine is the '<hidden cause> Makes You Fat - Here's How to Fix It' image advertorial family (112 distinct image winners in window per `counts`/`notes`), which a separate statics worker reads.

statement: For women 48-67 in or past menopause who gained weight 'without changing a single thing' and whose diets, cardio and doctors have failed them, Her Bodhi ('Her Bodhi Menopause Balance') is the natural two-capsule-a-day menopause supplement that lowers the cortisol that took over when estrogen dropped, so the body 'can finally let go of the weight'. Unlike Ozempic/'painful injections' and 'risky HRT', it is 100% natural, hormone-free, needle-free and 'under a dollar a day', proven by first-person 16-19 lb-in-three-weeks testimonials and a 'six clinically studied ingredients' / 600 mg studied-dose ashwagandha line.
category_language: 'Her Bodhi Menopause Balance' / 'menopause balance' capsules; 'two botanical capsules'; 'natural alternative' to injections; the behaviour is named 'cortisol maxing' / 'cortisol detox' / 'cortisol reset' / 'lowering your cortisol on purpose' (m4555298468024978 42d, m1632604497832654 30d, m1396625918621184 3d).
price_tier: value (inferred: 'under a dollar a day' m957740629947159 44d; perpetual 'up to 60% OFF + FREE Shipping + 3 Gifts' in 71 of 78 primary texts; 70% / code JULY4 in July; no list price ever named)
enemy: Food and willpower as the blamed cause ('the real issue wasn't food, it was stress hormones. That's why diets fail'), GLP-1 injections ('painful injections', 'sunken faces, lost muscle'), HRT ('no risky HRT, zero synthetic hormones'), doctors who say 'it's just your age' / 'your bloods are normal', and under-dosed supplements ('most have 300 to 400 milligrams of ashwagandha').
stands_for: You were never failing and it was never your age or your food: after menopause cortisol takes over, and two natural capsules a day bring it down so the weight, the puffiness, the 3am wake-ups and the cravings release without diets, needles or hormones.

one_line: Hers is a women's telehealth platform selling prescription access (GLP-1 weight loss, minoxidil hair pills, anxiety medication, a 130-marker lab panel) to women who want care online without appointments; it scales by flooding creator UGC (2,242 videos, 40 winners) that sells the access process itself.
statement: For women who want treatment for weight, hair, anxiety or unexplained exhaustion without a waiting room, Hers is the online care platform that gets them prescribed and delivered from home. Unlike in-person doctors and other telehealth sites, it is 100% online, needs no insurance, runs month to month and ships free, proven by creator testimonials of the process (m1589003919590724, 35d; m1575254717339946, 41d).
category_language: '100% online', 'no in-person appointments', 'a licensed provider reviewed my info', 'see if treatment is right for you', 'delivered to your door with free shipping if prescribed'
price_tier: value
enemy: the hassle and cost of in-person care: waiting rooms, insurance, complicated sites, doctors who only check one or two markers
stands_for: Women's healthcare made as easy as ordering online: answer questions, get reviewed, get it delivered.

statement: For women 30-50 who gained weight 'doing nothing different', Hormify is the natural two-capsule hormonal-balance supplement that makes the weight come off without diets, gyms or shots. Unlike Ozempic, strict diets and the gym, it 'balances your hormones' naturally and 'doesn't interfere with birth control', proven by stacked weight-loss testimonials (32-36 lb in three months) and 'Join +98,325 thrilled women'.
category_language: 'hormonal balance support', 'hormone support, not a fat burner', 'the one for hormonal weight', 'nature's Ozempic', 'Hormify 2.0 ... healthy weight management' (m1155391043680677, m1430593152591781, m1804738020515463)
price_tier: value (inferred: '$24.99 instead of $60', '$25 per bottle', '$105 deal' three-month pack; permanent 60% off framing)
enemy: Ozempic/injections ('no shots', 'no jabs', 'girl, what are you doing?'), strict diets and gym, 'your age' resignation, and since Oct, copycat fakes
stands_for: Weight loss after 30/40 is a hormone problem, not a willpower problem, and two natural pills fix it without effort.

statement: For people who wake up with a puffy face and a stress belly and sleep badly, Night Shred is the nighttime fat burner that 'attacks puffy face from three angles: cortisol, sleep and overnight metabolism'. Unlike diets, cardio, ice rolling or 'cortisol cocktails', it works while you sleep, two capsules before bed, proven by '12,000 five-star reviews', KSM-66 and grains of paradise ('clinically studied') and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
category_language: 'nighttime fat burner', 'nighttime fat burning and sleep support supplement', 'cortisol flushing formula', 'stress-relieving, fat-burning formula'; GLP-1 line: 'the first nighttime GLP-1 solution', 'a metabolic reset for your nights'
price_tier: value-to-mid (inferred: no unit price spoken; constant 20% off, 'Save up to $144', 'up to 41%/42% off' bundles, a quiz offer 'up to 67% off')
enemy: Cortisol itself, personified as a villain ('Haha, that's all me! High cortisol!'); secondarily the failed fixes (diet, cardio, crash diets, ice rolling, 'cortisol cocktails') and 'the modern world' (blue light, ultra-processed food)
stands_for: You are not fat, you are holding cortisol: drain the puffy face and stress belly overnight while you sleep.

one_line: iRESTORE sells FDA-cleared red-light hair-growth helmets (plus Apex body panels and face-mask bundles) to men and women with thinning hair, and scales on cheap-to-make UGC confessions and founder proof that run 150+ days, a premium price softened by 12-month guarantees and FSA/HSA framing.
statement: For adults watching their hair thin who want something that works without drugs or appointments, iRESTORE is the at-home red-light hair-growth helmet that regrows hair in 12 minutes a day. Unlike topicals and weaker caps, it claims 500 lasers and LEDs, triple wavelengths and FDA clearance, plus a 12-month money-back guarantee.
category_language: red light therapy, low-level laser therapy, 'medical grade lasers and LEDs', 'triple wavelength', FDA cleared, 'regrow', follicles, '12 minutes a day', 'most powerful at-home device'
price_tier: premium
enemy: products and topicals that 'don't work', cheap underpowered devices, complicated treatments (appointments, pills, shots), waiting too long
stands_for: Hair regrowth made hands-free, drug-free and clinically credible at home.

statement: For menopausal women 45+ whose belly 'pouch' has not moved despite diets, Kalm is the magnetic-therapy bracelet that breaks the 'silent cortisol loop' telling the body to store belly fat. Unlike diets, the gym, HRT or 'that overpriced supplement you saw on Facebook', it is worn, not taken ('no pills, no hormones'), works while you do nothing, and is backed by 'over 1,000 scientific studies' on magnetic therapy plus a 60-day results guarantee.
category_language: 'Magnetic therapy' / 'the Kalm bracelet' / 'six therapeutic hematite magnets combined with acupressure'. Problem named as 'cortisol belly', 'meno belly', 'hormonal weight', 'the pouch'. Mechanism phrase repeated in 5 of 6 scripts: 'break the silent cortisol loop' (m934002356113023 169d, m27225350867050911 167d, m738908222644409 162d).
price_tier: Not spoken in any script; inferred low-ticket impulse device (single-product PDP, '40% off your first order', body copy 'Limited Stock - Order Before It's Gone!'). Price not in the data.
enemy: Dieting and discipline first ('no amount of dieting will ever fix it', 'you don't need more discipline'), then explicitly the supplement category ('definitely not that overpriced supplement you saw on Facebook', 'diets, exercise and even supplements bounce off') and medication/HRT ('no pills, no hormones', 'my HRT treatment was causing a lot of side effects').
stands_for: Your belly is a hormone signal, not a failure of willpower; calm the nervous system and the belly follows, without pills.

one_line: A very high-volume testosterone-supplement engine (Atria counts 10,761 videos in 180 days) that runs a small set of re-uploaded 'reason-why' script bodies (symptom-stack callout, quit-the-crutch switcher story, dose exposé, wife-POV mock complaint, personified-cast animation) through hook swaps, many faces and a near-constant 50%-off-for-life + 90-day-guarantee offer, sending most traffic to a quiz (quiz-v6) or a 10-reasons listicle; in October it re-skinned the whole engine around a renamed product (Boost), an ex-NFL celebrity and a cortisol 'stress belly' reframe.

MaryRuth's sells vegan liquid and gummy vitamins, led by a 'viral' liquid morning multivitamin plus hair growth, to mass-market women wanting thicker hair and 'beauty from within', and scales on one huge creator-UGC batch plus silent BOGO 3-pack cuts sold on its site, Amazon and Walmart.
statement: For women who want thicker, fuller hair and glowing skin without pills, MaryRuth's is the clean vegan liquid multivitamin plus hair growth that supports hair 'from the inside out' and tastes like juice. Unlike topicals, shampoos and chalky tablets, it is one tasty daily dose with Lustriva, 'clinically shown to support thicker and fuller hair' and 'results in as early as three weeks'.
category_language: viral hair growth vitamin, liquid morning multivitamin plus hair growth, beauty from within, inside out, clinically shown, thicker fuller hair, hair goals
price_tier: mid
enemy: topicals, shampoos and 'boring' pill vitamins that sit unused; in October tests, 'the rosemary hairspray, the thickening shampoos' and 'haters' who called thin hair genetics
stands_for: Clean, tasty, easy daily nutrition that makes hair and skin goals feel simple, available everywhere.

one_line: A creator-and-codes volume machine (4,297 videos in 180 days, one page) that runs two audiences - trying to conceive and perimenopause - on the same few portable structures (confession-FAQ, comic 'am I dying or is it X', dismissed-by-doctor, method takedown, chart walk) plus a brand-made voiceover story and silent copy-led cards, re-cutting openers constantly and keeping the few that hold.

statement: For coffee drinkers who love the morning ritual but not the jitters, 2pm crash and anxiety, MUD\WTR is the low-caffeine functional-mushroom coffee alternative that gives 'calm, alert' energy in one cup. Unlike mushroom coffees ('regular coffee with a fairy-dust sprinkle'), it has no coffee in the OG blend, discloses 2,240mg of mushrooms (560mg each), is 100% USDA organic, and is backed by 60,000+ five-star reviews and Target/Costco distribution.
category_language: coffee alternative / 'not mushroom coffee'; 'reckless caffeination' as the named enemy; 'step your caffeine down'; 'not all energy is equal'; 'grounded not wired, clear not anxious' (Sep 2026 manifesto, m1824099585430400)
price_tier: mid-premium consumable: '$1.33 every cup' / 'about a dollar a cup' (m2312904466137170, m1787751452004235); 30-serving starter kit sold at 43% off, '$100 of product for $34' (m1495681902352766, inferred kit price ~$34-40)
enemy: Too much caffeine ('reckless caffeination'), not coffee itself: 'coffee was never the enemy, the caffeine was' (m998875949246468). Second enemy: weak, under-dosed, proprietary-blend mushroom coffees (m3226209410904037, m2347583749108334).
stands_for: Healthier daily rituals: keep the warm morning cup, drop the over-stimulation, and add enough functional mushrooms to matter.

statement: [Supercalm] For stressed adults (mostly women who 'do everything right') who want to feel calm, sleep and lose the 'cortisol face', Nello Supercalm is the tasty, pill-free calming drink mix that puts ashwagandha, L-theanine, magnesium glycinate and D3 in one packet. Unlike buying four supplements separately or taking pills, it is one flavoured mocktail, cheaper than the stack (m1115697400945524, m1360184425992670) with taste and sale scarcity as proof. Brand-wide: 'Nello did a thing' — functional drink mixes that collapse a supplement stack into one zero-sugar flavoured packet.
category_language: [Supercalm] 'calming drink mix', 'the calming drink that every adult needs' (m1728102151845003), 'therapy in a drink' (m1220174490249061), 'cortisol balancing supplement' (m1885310569113659), 'my secret little nightly mocktail' (m3078615858975697), 'my happy drink' (m1876923179659104). Brand-wide: 'drink mix', 'packets/sticks', 'tubs', 'mocktail'.
price_tier: mid (inferred): 'less than $2 a packet' [Superfocus] (m1681678596427607); '20 packets for like 40 50' [Supercalm] (m1832630051505720); 'up to 53%' off URLs; 'Everyone's always saying how Nello is so expensive' (m1454386446513546) suggests a premium perception it fights with constant sales.
enemy: [Supercalm] pills and buying 4 separate expensive supplements; melatonin ('melatonin free alternative', m1800561321326025); prescriptions ('my doctor said I can take prescription', m1454386446513546); drinking/smoking to sleep (m1136923725711493). [Superbalance] 'going on birth control/the pill' and blaming yourself or your man. [Superfocus/Energy] energy drinks, caffeine overload, sucralose, Adderall.
stands_for: Functional wellness you actually want to drink: one tasty zero-sugar packet instead of a cabinet of pills.

one_line: A creator-volume machine that wins with a few repeatable containers (taboo-warning UGC, 'nobody warned me about 40' peer-tenure PAS, named-symptom before/after, practitioner-referral story, and a narrated 'they buried it' manifesto), then scales by re-uploading the same proven file under many ad ids and swapping only the first line.

RYZE sells a six-mushroom 'adaptogenic' coffee that tastes like a latte to US coffee drinkers who want steady energy, less bloating and less stress, and scales on enormous test volume (8,726 videos, 625 winners) of long niche-pain scripts that all end in a 40%-off gift-stack offer.
statement: For coffee drinkers who want steady energy, a calmer gut and less stress without giving up their habits, RYZE is the mushroom coffee that puts six organic adaptogenic mushrooms in one latte-tasting cup. Unlike buying each mushroom separately ('hundreds of dollars'), it costs 'less than a dollar a cup', backed by '300,000 five-star reviews' and a 30-day empty-bag refund.
category_language: mushroom coffee, six adaptogenic mushrooms, 'used for centuries in Eastern/Chinese medicine', 'tastes like a smooth creamy latte', certified organic, grown in California, third-party tested, ritual kit
price_tier: mid
enemy: the habit and its fallout (nightly weed, drinks, midnight chips, donuts, soda), the regular-coffee crash, high cortisol, a bad gut / 'parasites'; never the viewer for keeping the habit
stands_for: Keep your life as it is; add one better cup in the morning (inferred from the 'not ready to quit? add this' and 'give me some backup' turns).

statement: For people (mostly women and moms) who have tried every supplement, diet and doctor and still have gut, stress or hormone symptoms, Silver Fern is the root-cause supplement house that sells clinically dosed multi-product protocols in the right order. Unlike underdosed single products, quick fixes or the doctor's 'Band-Aid' (laxatives, acid blockers, antibiotics), it fixes the system top-down. Proof offered: a founder who answers DMs himself, in-house PhD formulators, branded ingredients at clinical doses, and pre-launch testing where 80%+ must say 'it works'.
category_language: 'gut health company', 'root cause', 'protocol' / 'Step 1' / 'pre-cleanup', 'clinically studied ingredients at the clinical doses', 'not a laxative', 'signaling', 'HPA axis dysfunction', 'cortisol rhythm' (not 'level'), 'your liver deserves a little more love'. 'Detox' is used for gut (Cleanse 'daily gut detox') and liver, never for cortisol.
price_tier: Premium protocol pricing sold as value. The founder concedes 'It's expensive, it does cost money' (m1450613069608361, 171d) and that saffron is 'an expensive spice' (m1019995347036164, 142d). The only explicit price is Hair Complex at ~$27/month vs '$70 plus' competitors (m4374416029514011, 171d). Kits are bundles of 2-3 SKUs (inferred mid-to-high $ per order).
enemy: The Band-Aid: doctors' symptom management (laxatives, Miralax, Linzess, PPIs, antibiotics), underdosed margin-driven supplements made by contract-manufacturer food scientists, 'just change your diet' advice, and social-media health trends ('lower your cortisol', 'adrenal fatigue', 'cortisol belly', single-ingredient fixes).
stands_for: Someone finally cares enough to fix the real cause: a family business that tells you the science bluntly, gives you the exact protocol and dose, and won't spam you.

statement: For UK coffee drinkers (now led by men 35+ with a hard 'cortisol belly'/'man boobs', second by women in perimenopause and menopause with evening bloat) who train and diet and still can't shift the middle, Rainbow Dust is the adaptogen-and-mushroom 'cortisol drink' that replaces the morning coffee and brings cortisol down so the body 'stops getting the signal to hold on'. Unlike coffee, fat burners, cardio, crash diets and 'cheap ashwagandha off Amazon', it uses 'clinically dosed KSM-66 ashwagandha' plus chaga, cordyceps and lion's mane at 'proper doses' with only 80mg caffeine, backed by '1M+ users' and a 60-day 'even on an empty bag' guarantee.
category_language: 'Adaptogen and functional mushroom blend', 'mushroom blend', 'the cortisol drink' (m1568479207934881, m1403171095236587), 'coffee upgraded, not a coffee replacement' and the late-Oct rename 'Coffee Plus' (m1632707128317342). A second advertiser identity, 'The Cortisol Reset' (pages m1281061911765866 / m1142636272273149), runs the same product and PDP. Problem named 'cortisol belly', 'cortisol gut', 'visceral fat', 'stress fat', 'stuck poop weight', 'hormonal belly'.
price_tier: mid (inferred): starter kit £29-£39 spoken (m1463411139156391, m1729077351721848, m1291594146513802), '£40 for mushrooms' full price (m1580447923613427), 'about a quid a day/cup' on deal (m1302514341513663, m1041341715627636); permanently discounted 'up to 58% off' (occasionally 69%).
enemy: Coffee first ('Your morning coffee is fueling everything you're trying to fix', m933899196296983 52d); then 'out-training a hormone' with cardio/clean eating (m2859911251055482), fat burners and crash diets (m1852644362758875), underdosed competitors ('the ashwagandha in most supplements is a pinch', m28662784203384054), doctors who say 'it's very normal' (dad film, m2196487591082872), and one-thing-at-a-time supplement buying ('an order not a list', m1695571679235845).
stands_for: Your stubborn middle is a cortisol problem your coffee keeps re-triggering, so swap one morning drink and the body lets go.

one_line: Thesis sells stimulant-free nootropic capsules, mainly Clarity for focus and brain fog to 25-45 knowledge workers and young men, plus a smaller Stress Reset cortisol line for moms and stressed women; it scales on huge batches of near-identical UGC and talking-brain-chemical animation cuts.
statement: For knowledge workers and strivers who can't lock in, Thesis Clarity is the nootropic that rebuilds the brain chemicals behind focus. Unlike coffee, energy drinks or 'stimulants in disguise', it works without jitters or a crash, backed by 'Yale-educated scientists' and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
category_language: nootropic, 'Nature's Adderall', 'locked in', 'focus without the crash', dopamine / acetylcholine / BDNF, neuroplasticity; Stress Reset: 'clinically-proven calm', 'support healthy cortisol levels'
price_tier: mid
enemy: caffeine and stimulants ('stimulants in disguise', the 3 pm crash), 'cheap dopamine' (scrolling, porn, junk food), and for Stress Reset the soft advice ('the breathing exercises, the journaling, the just go for a walk')
stands_for: Your brain isn't broken, it's running low on specific chemicals, and a daily formula can refill them without a stimulant.

one_line: A founder-voice template factory: a handful of short (15-60s) modular scripts (wordplay, objection ladder, fake apology, flavour drop, 7-day stat stack) are re-uploaded dozens of times and re-cut with new rungs, while creators, street interviews and text-on-screen memes fill volume, almost all sent to one intro-offer page.

statement: For women 40+ (mostly perimenopausal and menopausal) who will not give up their morning coffee but feel wired, crashing, bloated and stuck with belly weight, Vahdam Ashwagandha Coffee is the functional instant coffee that turns the daily cup from a cortisol spike into cortisol support. Unlike regular coffee (blamed for spiking cortisol) and unlike gummies, capsules or mushroom coffee, it puts 300mg KSM-66 per two cups into a habit you never forget, and it 'tastes like proper coffee'.
category_language: 'ashwagandha coffee', 'coffee upgraded with five wellness ingredients', 'smarter coffee', 'functional coffee', 'the only coffee on Target shelves that addresses cortisol' (m1671433784073604, 0d)
price_tier: value-to-mid (inferred: no coffee price is spoken; '$4 off at Target' and Target shelf placement imply a mass-retail price point; the curcumin capsule is '$35')
enemy: Regular coffee ('your coffee is working against you', m1121341930617991, 3d, scaling) and, second, the pill/gummy routine you forget; third, mushroom coffee that 'doesn't touch cortisol'
stands_for: Keep the ritual, swap the cup: the cortisol fix is a better version of a habit you already have, not a new one.

one_line: WarriorBabe sells strength-and-macros coaching (a $27 Macro Method course up front, high-ticket coached programme behind a quiz and a book-a-call) to US women over 40 whose weight changed in perimenopause and menopause, and scales on founder education clips and member rescue stories that run 118-175 days.
statement: For women over 40 whose weight won't budge since menopause, WarriorBabe is the strength-and-macros coaching programme that lets them eat more, lift and get toned. Unlike keto, Jenny Craig, Weight Watchers or intense workouts, it gives each woman her own macros and a coach, proven by member stories ('21,800 women').
category_language: macros, metabolism, menopause weight gain, eat more, strength training, toned, 'fired their last diet', women over 40
price_tier: premium
enemy: restrictive diets and calorie cutting, endless cardio, the diet industry ('built to keep you buying the next one'), generic trainers who 'don't understand menopause'
stands_for: Women over 40 can eat more, lift and own their bodies again; the problem was never them.

one_line: WeightWatchers sells a points-based diet programme (app, coaches, community, now GLP-1 access via Med+) to mainstream dieters, and scales on an always-on, claim-free 'new Weight Watchers' brand film cut per market plus app-feature snippets.
statement: For people who want to lose weight without giving up the foods they love, WeightWatchers is the weight-loss programme that adapts to you (points, app, coaches, community, medication if you qualify). Unlike going it alone or 'a doctor who writes a script and wishes you luck', it gives support backed by 60+ years and millions of members.
category_language: weight loss programme, points budget, ZeroPoint foods, coaches trained in behavior science, community, accountability, 'the new Weight Watchers'
price_tier: mid
enemy: doing it alone, the outdated image of WW ('your mom's / grandma's Weight Watchers'), rigid food rules, the script-only GLP-1 prescriber
stands_for: There is more than one way to succeed, and you do not have to do it alone.

one_line: A GLP-1 side-effect supplement run as a whitelisted-creator content factory: 2-5 minute mechanism-education bodies (clinician monologue, relative-insider story, personified villain, mini-drama skit) each carrying 4-7 swapped first lines, plus 13-second silent meme cuts, all routed to angle-specific landing pages and third-party advertorials; 1,279 videos and 166 30-day survivors in roughly six months.

A UK/NL/US men's testosterone all-in-one (T1, 14 ingredients) that scales on two engines: endlessly re-cut celebrity podcast and fighter content (Apr-May era, 100-134 day families) and, since September, narrator-led 'what would happen if he took it for N days' ingredient timelines and 'N signs' callouts that send cold traffic straight to the PDP with a 3+3 or 50%-off offer, refreshed by first-line swaps and offer re-skins.
